name: work-skill
description: Portable Agent Skills for responsibility-driven development, Java design patterns, Android Clean Architecture, multilingual coding style, naming, and Chinese Conventional Commits.

interface.shortDescription: 跨 Agent 的职责驱动设计、代码规范与中文 Git 工作流
interface.longDescription: 以开放 Agent Skills 格式提供职责驱动的业务建模、架构设计和渐进式重构流程，Java 设计模式知识库，多语言命名与代码规范，以及安全的中文 Conventional Commit 工作流。
defaultPrompt: Use $responsibility-driven-development to model this business problem, assign responsibilities, and design the smallest maintainable solution.
Use $naming-conventions to review these identifiers and suggest clearer names.
Use $language-coding-style to review this code change for style issues.
Use $java-design-patterns to assess this Java design, refactoring, or optimization problem and apply a pattern only when it solves a concrete issue.
Use $git-commit-zh to create a Chinese Conventional Commit for this work.
